description: Get the secure page where the user submits a test-number code. Takes no code on purpose, because a tool call is stored in the conversation. Returns entry_url with the time and attempts left, or no_code when none is waiting. Read-only: it does not confirm the number. Never ask for the code in chat, and do not accept one pasted here: it is a secret and this conversation is stored.

workspace.description: Act in this workspace, e.g. one of your client workspaces (id from list_workspaces). Default: the workspace this connection uses.
